theorem AnnealSail.execute_add_effects : Functions.execute
    (instruction.RTYPE (regidx.Regidx 2, regidx.Regidx 1, regidx.Regidx 3, rop.ADD)) =
  FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regRead Register.x1 none))) fun a =>
    FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regRead Register.x2 none))) fun b =>
      FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regWrite Register.x3 none (a + b)))) fun x =>
        FreeM.pure (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ()) :=
Eq.refl (Functions.execute (instruction.RTYPE (regidx.Regidx 2, regidx.Regidx 1, regidx.Regidx 3, rop.ADD)))

theorem AnnealSail.execute_add_full_state : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64) (s : SequentialState RegisterType),
  s.regs.get? Register.x1 = some a →
    s.regs.get? Register.x2 = some b →
      EStateM.run
          (interpretSailEffects
            (Functions.execute (instruction.RTYPE (regidx.Regidx 2, regidx.Regidx 1, regidx.Regidx 3, rop.ADD))))
          s =
        EStateM.Result.ok (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ())
          { regs := s.regs.insert Register.x3 (a + b), mem := s.mem, tags := s.tags, cycleCount := s.cycleCount,
            sailOutput := s.sailOutput } :=
fun a b s h1 h2 =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          EStateM.run (interpretSailEffects _a) s =
            EStateM.Result.ok (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ())
              { regs := s.regs.insert Register.x3 (a + b), mem := s.mem, tags := s.tags, cycleCount := s.cycleCount,
                sailOutput := s.sailOutput })
        execute_add_effects))
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg
                (fun x =>
                  match
                    (match x with
                      | some s => pure s
                      | x => throw Sail.Error.Unreachable)
                      s with
                  | EStateM.Result.ok a s =>
                    (fun res =>
                        FreeM.liftM
                          (fun x =>
                            match x with
                            | Sum.inl (Except.error err) => throw err
                            | Sum.inl (Except.ok eff) => interpretInstructionEffect eff
                            | Sum.inr choice =>
                              let c := choice;
                              if h : 0 < c then pure ⟨0, h⟩ else throw Sail.Error.Unreachable)
                          ((fun a =>
                              FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regRead Register.x2 none))) fun b =>
                                FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regWrite Register.x3 none (a + b))))
                                  fun x => FreeM.pure (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ()))
                            res))
                      a s
                  | EStateM.Result.error e s => EStateM.Result.error e s)
                h1)
              (congrArg
                (fun x =>
                  match
                    (match x with
                      | some s => pure s
                      | x => throw Sail.Error.Unreachable)
                      s with
                  | EStateM.Result.ok a_1 s =>
                    (fun res =>
                        FreeM.liftM
                          (fun x =>
                            match x with
                            | Sum.inl (Except.error err) => throw err
                            | Sum.inl (Except.ok eff) => interpretInstructionEffect eff
                            | Sum.inr choice =>
                              let c := choice;
                              if h : 0 < c then pure ⟨0, h⟩ else throw Sail.Error.Unreachable)
                          ((fun b =>
                              FreeM.impure (Sum.inl (Except.ok (InstructionEffect.regWrite Register.x3 none (a + b))))
                                fun x => FreeM.pure (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ()))
                            res))
                      a_1 s
                  | EStateM.Result.error e s => EStateM.Result.error e s)
                h2)))
          (EStateM.Result.ok (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ())
            { regs := s.regs.insert Register.x3 (a + b), mem := s.mem, tags := s.tags, cycleCount := s.cycleCount,
              sailOutput := s.sailOutput }))
        (eq_self
          (EStateM.Result.ok (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ())
            { regs := s.regs.insert Register.x3 (a + b), mem := s.mem, tags := s.tags, cycleCount := s.cycleCount,
              sailOutput := s.sailOutput }))))
